title: Euthicrates
summary: Raleigh names Euthicrates in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Euthicrates, whom with Lasthenes Philip bought from the Olynthians, by whose treason he entred the Towne. The printed spelling, including the space in Euthicrate s if so printed, is kept as the surface requires. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter I, §. V, sig. 462b–463a
